study.question: Can learned inter-group relevance, with group-size multiplicity removed, improve the paired_match plus target-readout hybrid over equal group mass, and is any gain specific to target queries?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g3-r0007-balanced_target AUC .6202303848951921 exceeds paired_match .6191087654101018 and target_separate .6153351063827704, but exceeds balanced_context by only .0002223245870622 and global_uniform by .0000978785324588. Round 6 target/context separate readouts were .6198705488/.6200552833. Raw-magnitude round 8 fell to .6196326415/.6196195002; round 9 groupwise norm matching gave .6199113683/.6199145944 and erased conditioning advantage. These are single-seed trajectories, not independent confirmations. Source inspection of incumbent _group_weights proves invariance to ANY additive score offset within a group: equal occupied-group mass removes inter-group score relevance. Candidate-supplied first-512 diagnostics in balanced_target report .91137 neither-match event fraction, .92850 global attention mass and .57398 equal-group mass; group balancing changes a large allocation, not a demonstrated optimal one. Hypothesis: exp(score)/group_size can retain a size-neutral prior while allowing learned group evidence to redirect mass. Better signal allocation might preserve the useful globally normalized geometry without enforcing equal group relevance. This is provisional; no utility, significance or novelty is established.

study.proposed_difference: For valid event i in occupied group g of size n_g, define w_i=softmax_valid(s_i-log(n_g)). Equivalently, first softmax within each group, then set group mass pi_g proportional to mean_{i in g} exp(s_i). Incumbent pi_g=1/K. Thus relative within-group weights are unchanged for fixed scores while inter-group relevance is restored without a size prior. Global attention pi_g proportional to sum exp(s_i) remains an existing utility comparison, not the proposed rule. For constant scores all occupied groups have equal mass; duplicating every event of a single group preserves the group distribution and summary; group score shifts now change group mass. Do not claim invariance to duplicating only a subset or all repeated exposures. All four standalone variants run the same allocations and differ only in evidence_mass and target_query. This is a parameter-free logit correction/hierarchical attention implementation; broader priority is unverified. Scoped paper searches for softmax/group returned no indexed match and are not an exhaustive novelty search. Density softmax uses the same finite-dtype mask minimum as the inherited equal-group softmax; the global utility helper retains its original -1e4 sentinel for provenance. No host failure has been observed.
predictions: Primary utility: density_target has higher full-population validation AUC than equal_target and both frozen source bests; report unweighted logloss, total/dense parameters, GPU/wall seconds, examples, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95 latency. AUC and loss may disagree as they did in rounds 8-9.

Attribution: density_target-equal_target is positive, density_target exceeds density_context, and the difference-in-differences [(density_target-equal_target)-(density_context-equal_context)] is positive if target-conditioned inter-group relevance specifically helps. Conditioning evidence remains preliminary until paired seeds.

Algebra/diagnostics: event mass sums to one for nonempty histories and zero for empty ones; masked mass is zero; theoretical group mean-exp masses match actual density masses; within-group conditional weights match equal-mass conditional weights; one occupied group gives equal outputs; a whole-group replication changes neither mass nor summary at fixed scores/queries.

Model diagnostics are label-free first-512 checkpoint observations, not full-population performance. Compare fixed-group target/context replacements and score-offset interventions without claiming counterfactual validity. Padding, joint event permutation and empty/zero-length histories preserve intended behavior.

Exploratory slices use existing fixed host bins: history length, hour, behavior composition, train frequency and category-match presence; carry sample/positive/negative counts. Do not create post-hoc confirmatory slices from first-512 diagnostics.
falsifiers: Failure to exceed equal_target or paired_match leaves incremental utility unsupported; failure to exceed target_separate also fails the stated combination criterion. A single losing implementation does not refute adaptive group weighting in general.
Equal or greater gain from density_context, no target-context advantage, or a nonpositive interaction leaves target-specific conditioning unsupported even if both density cells improve.

If mass predictions, within-group invariance, padding/permutation checks, finite logits, empty/zero-length semantics or matched parameter allocation fail, treat it as an implementation/integrity failure rather than scientific evidence.
If a promising difference disappears or reverses under paired seeds 43/44, keep the initial outcome as a single-seed observation and do not promote it to repeated support.
If gains require unacceptable measured cost or do not improve the quality-cost frontier, do not claim efficiency. Identical parameter count does not establish equal compute.
alternative_explanations: Learned group evidence may encode generic salience, softmax temperature or changed gradient coupling rather than target relevance; matched context and full factorial contrast discriminate partly, not completely.

logmeanexp emphasizes extreme scores and depends on within-group score dispersion. It may amplify noise or correlations with group size even after explicit multiplicity correction; no claim of statistically unbiased relevance is made.
Current match membership itself depends on target equality. Context controls replace only query content and are not fully target-independent models.
All existing gains and losses are seed-42 observations. Identical same-seed normalized controls reproduce code/protocol behavior and are not new seed repetitions.

Final global norm matching entangles direction and gradients; shared embeddings can transmit allocation changes into the original feature path. Changed empty-history performance would reflect training rather than history information in those rows.

Global_uniform is close to the incumbent; the appended path and its classifier capacity may explain much of the hybrid utility. Both frozen source bests remain utility controls, not capacity-matched mechanism controls.
Publisher user/ad snapshot as-of dates remain undocumented. The frozen benchmark assumption is preserved; no production causality claim.
